strings: m_c sighs sadly as r_c suggests that it's time to take {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail off. The flesh is blackened from frostbite and is obviously dead; there's no use in leaving it attached. m_c agrees.
m_c's tail can hardly even move. r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that the frostbite has progressed too far: if m_c is to survive, the tail will have to be removed.

m_c's tail is finally gone. It's more of a relief than anything. The frostbitten flesh was already dead and blackened, so {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had no issue with taking it off before it fell off on its own.
